title.text: BRAVIA Home — white keycaps, a hint of nature

how.text:
Quiet keys, rich scene. The keys stay simple frosted-glass keycaps with just the app name; the nature lives in the wallpaper behind them, like Apple TV.

• Ume: ink-wash mountains in mist, red sun over water, a boat, a plum branch across the top, red petals drifting.
• Sakura: a cherry tree in full bloom, petals falling and lying on the ground.
• Yuki: snowy mountains, snow-laden pines, steady snowfall (a few flakes drift in front of the keys).

The focused key grows, casts a soft shadow and catches a sheen. One row of apps + 'All apps' leaves the bottom of the scene visible. The theme can follow the season from the TV clock, no internet needed.

pick.text:
Try it: press Play on a board and hover the keys — the focused key lifts, as it would when you move with the remote.

Pick one, or let them change with the seasons.
